applications.title: Enclave at Parkside - Preliminary Plan & Pattern Book
applications.description: Preliminary plan and pattern book for the Enclave at Parkside, a 47-unit residential subdivision (side-by-side townhomes) within the Warfield PEC development. Includes open space, stormwater management, and future commercial parcels.

citations.excerpt: Three-step approval process: concept, preliminary, final.
citations.note: PEC three-step approval process governs subdivision review.

citations.excerpt: A pattern book shall be submitted and approved as part of the preliminary plan phase.
citations.note: Pattern book required for preliminary plan approval.

citations.excerpt: The plan remains consistent with all land use percentages approved during the concept plan stage.
citations.note: Land use percentages verified at preliminary stage.

citations.excerpt: The plan remains consistent with all bulk regulations approved during the concept plan stage.
citations.note: Bulk regulations (lot area, width, yards) verified at preliminary stage.

applications.title: Rezone Petition - 7306 Springfield Ave (Joy Property)
applications.description: Rezone petition requesting zoning change from Business Local (B-L) to Business General (B-G) at 7306 Springfield Ave to allow legal operation of an automobile service garage. The property historically operated as a service station but lost non-conforming status. If approved by Town Council, a site plan review will still be required.

applications.title: Site Plan - 7503 Village Rd (Rob's Barber Shop)
applications.description: Site plan review for conversion of a convenience store at 7503 Village Rd into a barber shop. The 2,000 sq ft building layout remains unchanged; primary modification is restriping parking to add a handicap accessible space.

applications.title: Conditional Use Request for Assisted Living - Warfield Parcel B
applications.description: Conditional use approval for an assisted living facility on Parcel B in the Warfield Development. Reviewed by PC for recommendation to BZA.

citations.excerpt: Applicant is requesting conditional use approval of an assisted living facility to be located on Parcel B in the Warfield Development.
citations.note: §180-137 A(2)(b) - assisted living listed as conditional use in PEC zone. Extracted from staff report.

citations.excerpt: The purpose of the PEC zone is to provide for logical locations where high-quality mixed use developments can occur.
citations.note: Staff report evaluates proposal against PEC purpose criteria. Extracted from staff report.
